items.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
items.summary: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.

items.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
items.summary: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

items.title: AlphaFi Winds Down After Oracle Error, With Sui Foundation Support
items.summary: New deposits and loans are disabled, while Slush users are told to exit four strategies with immediate withdrawals.

items.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
items.summary: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.
